title: Quadratic expressions and equations
summary: Expanding and factorising, algebraic fractions, monic and non-monic trinomials, completing the square, and solving quadratics by factorising and the quadratic formula.

cards.title: Expanding expressions
cards.rule: Multiply every term in one bracket by every term in the other.

cards.title: Factorising expressions
cards.rule: Take out the HCF first, then look for the difference of two squares.

cards.title: Algebraic fractions: × and ÷
cards.rule: Factorise everything, cancel common factors, then multiply. To divide, flip the second fraction.

cards.title: Monic trinomials
cards.rule: \(x^2 + bx + c\): two numbers that multiply to \(c\) and add to \(b\).

cards.title: Non-monic trinomials
cards.rule: Find two numbers that multiply to \(ac\) and add to \(b\), split the middle term, then group.

cards.title: Completing the square
cards.rule: Add and subtract \(\left(\tfrac b2\right)^2\): \(x^2 + bx = \left(x + \tfrac b2\right)^2 - \left(\tfrac b2\right)^2\)

cards.title: Solving by factorising
cards.rule: Make one side zero, factorise, then use the Null Factor Law.

cards.title: Applications of quadratics
cards.rule: Write the equation, solve it, then check which answers make sense.
lines: A ball's height is \(h = 20t - 5t^2\). When is it 15 m up?
cards.note: Two answers: once going up, once coming down.

cards.title: Solving by completing the square
cards.rule: Complete the square, then take the square root of both sides (±).

cards.title: The quadratic formula
cards.rule: \(x = \dfrac{-b \pm \sqrt{b^2 - 4ac}}{2a}\). The discriminant \(\Delta = b^2 - 4ac\) gives the number of solutions.
